delivery.outcome: Define one canonical tamper-evident logs.dsl.txt contract for governed lifecycle events
nonGoals: No runtime, CLI, SDK or workflow implementation in this architecture slice
No tracked post-merge log mutation or audit recursion
No secret values or unbounded provider payloads
No reconstruction claims without retained trusted evidence

architecture.decision: Persist logs.dsl.txt as an immutable run or workflow artifact with canonical event ordering and a SHA-256 digest chain, never as a post-merge self-mutating commit
dataChanges: Introduce the versioned t2c.event-log/v1 persistent artifact contract
architecture.rollback: Remove the unimplemented contract and fixture before any runtime producer adopts t2c.event-log/v1

validation.evidence: The closed grammar and bounded integration scope are governance-valid
The canonical fixture has all required event families and a valid digest chain
Every event has mandatory provenance and cryptographic bindings
Repository checks preserve the fact, decision and advisory trust boundary
